title: The Simmering Moon
notes: Season 2 begins November 1: a 150-tier pass with three new lanterns, Simmer, Alembic and Philter.
The cauldron: foes drop ingredients you brew into potions, and the Recipe book keeps every recipe you find.
The Far Hollow: eleven new worlds, each with its own foe, boss, twist and music.
A new Performance setting: Auto, Smooth or Full effects.
